content_sections.heading: About Panjab University Project Associate-I
content_sections.text: Applications are invited for two Project Associate -1 positions for research purposes under a CSR grant for using AI in Material Science/Characterization. The project will be executed at Panjab University, Chandigarh, under Principal Investigator Professor Gaurav Verma.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There are a total of 02 (two) posts for Project Associate-I. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the following criteria set by Panjab University:

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The initial offer will be for one year and renewable for up to two more years subject to satisfactory performance. The position is temporary and co-terminus with the project (may be terminated anytime due to non-performance and withdrawal of the grant). Fellowship is 31,000/- + HRA or 25,000/- + HRA depending on qualification category.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Prescribed application format (Page 4-6) Recent passport size photograph (to be inserted/pasted on the application form and collected at an appropriate stage) Photocopies of relevant certificates and other testimonials in support of age, qualification, experience etc. (to be collected at an appropriate stage) Original certificates at the time of joining for the purpose of verification, along with one set of photocopies

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: List of shortlisted candidates for further selection process will be notified through email only. No TA/DA will be admissible for appearing for the interview. Selected candidates will have to join duty immediately on receipt of the offer. Candidates selected for this position can also apply for the regular PhD program of Panjab University Chandigarh, provided they satisfy the eligibility criteria (www.puchd.ac.in).

faq.question: Q1. What is the Project Associate-I recruitment at Panjab University?
faq.answer: Applications are invited for two Project Associate -1 positions for research purposes under a CSR grant for using AI in Material Science/Characterization to be executed at Panjab University, Chandigarh.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Associate-I?
Q3. What is the last date to apply for this position?
faq.answer: The last date is 06.11.2026 up to 4.00 P.M.

faq.question: Q4. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Master’s Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences/ MVSc or bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine from a recognized University or equivalent.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Preferably not more than 35 years as on closing date of Advertisement.

faq.question: Q6. What is the fellowship amount offered?
faq.answer: (i) 31,000/- + HRA to Scholars who are selected through National Eligibility Tests (CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship / GATE / Central Government national level exams); (ii) 25,000/- + HRA for others.

faq.question: Q7. Is the appointment permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The appointment is purely temporary and will terminate automatically without any notice or compensation on termination of the research project/non-performance of the selected candidate.

faq.question: Q8. How should candidates submit their application?
faq.answer: Interested candidates should send the application by post in the prescribed format (Page 4-6) to Prof Gaurav Verma, Director CIL/SAIF/USIC/UCIM, Sector 14, Panjab University Chandigarh.
